jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.jd: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team. The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem. Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost. Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up. Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building. Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback. Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality. Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down. Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next. Inspire us by Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus. Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them. Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus. End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality. Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders. Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving. Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus. What we offer Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday) Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best Innovation through diversity Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us. Still here? Then we might be the perfect match! It’s best to apply through our application portal - this way, your application lands directly with our team and we can review it quickly and easily. Ready to own (y)our growth? jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (m/f/d) – Multi-Agent Systems
jobs.jd: Anyone can build an AI agent demo these days. Getting agents to run reliably in production, for thousands of users worldwide, is a different story. That's the job. For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for an AI Engineer to take an existing AI innovation platform to the next level. The platform is already live and used across the entire company. Now it is being expanded into a multi-agent system that develops ideas on its own, evaluates them, analyzes markets and competitors, and delivers a solid business case at the end. Humans stay in the loop where decisions matter. What makes this role different You don't write concepts that end up in a drawer. You build the actual system. One product, one team, one location, with no constantly changing client projects and no travel. You work directly with the innovation team and its users, see how they really work, and ship improvements in days, not quarters. Think startup speed, enterprise scale: you'll build a product used across a global organization, with direct access to users and the opportunity to make things happen. The goal is ambitious: a global rollout within 12 months and a lighthouse project for what AI can do inside a global corporation. What you will do Build and orchestrate multi-agent systems that carry an idea from the first sketch to the business case Engineer system prompts, RAG pipelines, evaluation frameworks and feedback loops that make the agents better every week Integrate the platform with enterprise systems, innovation processes and identity and permission concepts Run what you build, with CI/CD, MLOps, monitoring and an eye on cost and reliability Actively shape the global rollout What you bring A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, industrial engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience Several years of building and shipping software in production, ideally LLM-based products used by real users Strong hands-on skills in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript/React Practical experience with multi-agent orchestration (e.g. LangGraph or similar frameworks), RAG and LLM evaluation; familiarity with MCP is a plus Solid experience with cloud, DevOps and MLOps as well as APIs and authentication/authorization concepts An MVP-first mindset: you ship early, measure honestly and cut what doesn't work The ability to explain a technical trade-off to an executive in the morning and debug a pipeline in the afternoon Fluent English; German is a plus, but not a must You'll stand out if you have founded a company, been an early engineer at a startup, or worked as a forward deployed or solutions engineer. The essentials Start ASAP, on-site in Munich, full-time, with a long-term engagement initially planned for around two years. You will be employed by advanced engineering GmbH and work directly with our client's project team. Interested? Apply with the button on this page. No cover letter needed. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) - Canada
jobs.jd: At NerdWallet , our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs. We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization. In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet. Where you can make an impact: Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization. Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability. Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert. Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications. Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale. Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility. Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation. Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness. Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization. Your experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact. Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. Please note: this role requires hands-on Databricks experience specifically, and experience with similar platforms is not a substitute. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with extensive experience using modern machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. Strong understanding of supervised learning, predictive modeling, classification, regression, ranking, and model evaluation techniques. Practical experience designing scalable batch and/or real-time inference systems, with an understanding of latency, reliability, and performance trade-offs. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, modular code design, and CI/CD practices for machine learning. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives from problem definition through deployment and business impact measurement. Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, conversion improvement, customer lifetime value, and marketing efficiency. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction and working effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Where: This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec). NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family. What we offer: Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?) Monthly Healthcare Stipend Rejuvenation Policy – Vacation Time Off + You will receive the official public holidays in your province Paid sabbatical for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge and pursue their interests Monthly Wellness Stipend, Wifi Stipend, and Cell Phone Stipend Work from home eq

jobs.title: Applied AI Data Scientist
jobs.jd: AE Studio builds products, platforms, and internal ventures that increase agency for all conscious beings. We combine world-class software engineering, AI expertise, and product design to ship ambitious projects that matter. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Data Scientist at AE Studio, you’ll work on a mix of client projects and internal research initiatives. You’ll solve real-world problems, help build meaningful products, and contribute to groundbreaking AI alignment research. Your work will involve building data-driven solutions, leveraging machine learning models, and using your creativity to deliver results that matter. In addition to client projects, you’ll have the opportunity to propose and pursue high-impact research projects , especially those aligned with our mission of increasing agency. Promising projects could even become prioritized skunkworks initiatives. We want problem-solvers who are adaptable, collaborative, and excited to push boundaries. If this sounds like you, let’s talk. ABOUT YOU You thrive on solving challenging problems and bring a mix of technical expertise, creativity, and humor to your work. You enjoy working independently but also love collaborating with a team that shares your passion for making a difference. Required Skills and Experience Fluency in Python .. Experience with LLM lifecycle: prompt design/engineering, prompting techniques (RAG, few-shot, CoT, etc.), vector databases, multimodality, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Proven data science experience : You’ve been a key contributor to impactful projects and know how to deliver results with real-life outcomes. Statistical & causal ML fundamentals: expertise in experimental design, uncertainty quantification, and rigorous model evaluation across tabular, time-series, and foundation-model fine-tuning tasks. Deep learning experience : Expertise in building/training NLP or computer vision models with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. Agile & AI-powered development: You run lean Kanban/Scrum cycles and leverage AI-powered tools like Cursor to prototype quickly and ship high-impact solutions. Growth mindset : You embrace challenges, value progress over perfection, and constantly seek to improve. Self-management : You can work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver without constant oversight. Product and UX understanding : You care about delivering a seamless, user-friendly experience. Effective communication in English : Clear, concise, and maybe even witty communication is essential. Bonus Points for Self-managed projects : Ideally something that you helped develop from zero and shipped to real users. Startup experience : You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy taking on new challenges. Client relationship management : Experience managing clients and delivering excellent results. Passion for AI alignment : You care deeply about humanity’s future and want to help navigate the challenges of advancing AI. WHAT WE OFFER Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or join us in one of our offices. Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, not micromanagement. Competitive pay: Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program. Opportunities for growth: Work on cutting-edge R&D and propose projects that could become our next skunkworks focus. Supportive environment: A team that collaborates, mentors, and shares knowledge. Perks: Health insurance, free lunches (at the office), weekly knowledge-sharing talks, and an annual team retreat. The salary range is $180k to $ 240k per year for people based in California. Not in the range? That's fine, you can still apply, and our team may fit you in a more senior position that we're not actively hiring right now, but we are growing fast and may have other openings soon. EQUITY Working at AE means receiving equity in our client projects and in Skunkworks ventures. The equity is priced at $0 when granted for tax reasons, but AE invests millions into these projects. Equity comes from reduced margins on client work and internal funding. You get a real stake in the things you help build. The longer you stay, the more value you create and the more equity you receive. If you leave on good terms, you can retain 20% of your equity by staying engaged. If you spin out a Skunkworks venture, you retain 100%.

jobs.title: Senior Data Science Engineer (LLM & NLP)
jobs.jd: Description An AI-driven financial technology company leveraging proprietary AI models and advanced language technologies to deliver fundamental insights on global stocks in multiple languages. Its generative AI technology is integrated into brokerage platforms and financial institutions, providing millions of investors with instant, data-driven stock analysis. As a Senior Data Science Engineer , you will research, develop, and deploy LLM, NLP, and ML models, as well as the model-driven services powering conversational AI solutions. You will own the entire development lifecycle — from problem definition and data exploration to model development, evaluation, and deployment of production-ready services. Responsibilities: Conversational AI & LLMs: multi-turn dialogue, context handling and answer generation over financial data; prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use and agent workflows; RAG pipelines over financial documents; fine-tune or train own LLMs where an API model isn't the best fit; reduce hallucinations, latency and cost per request. NLP models: train, fine-tune and maintain BERT-based models (intent detection, classification, entity extraction, embeddings); prepare and label data; decide when a smaller specialized model should replace an LLM call. LLM services in production: Python services within a 20+ microservice system; model routing, fallbacks, retries, caching, rate-limit handling; versioned REST APIs; clean, tested code and code reviews. Evaluation & monitoring: quality metrics and evaluation datasets; automated evaluation including LLM-as-a-judge and regression tests for prompt/model changes; tracing of LLM calls; experiments and A/B tests. AWS: train, deploy and operate models on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, SageMaker, GPU instances); CI/CD for models and prompts with DevOps; track and reduce cost. Collaboration: work with product, backend, DevOps and financial domain experts; contribute to architecture and modelling decisions. Requirements Must-have: 5+ years of commercial experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or AI Engineering 3+ years hands-on with LLMs and NLP Strong Python, OOP and software engineering fundamentals Proficient prompt engineering; experience with LLM evaluation Good understanding of modern deep-learning architectures; hands-on with PyTorch or TensorFlow SQL and NoSQL databases Docker and containerized applications; deploying and operating services on Kubernetes Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) Upper-Intermediate English or higher (spoken and written) Fluency in Ukrainian BSc or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field Nice to have: RAG, vector databases and semantic search Fine-tuning or training LLMs Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Langfuse, LangSmith Financial markets / fintech / trading domain knowledge Mathematical optimization (LP/MILP, constraint programming) Kaggle competitions Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.jd: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, AI/ML, Generative AI) About Us Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We’re a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian. We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world’s largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences. As an award-winning Atlassian partner with a world-class team, we help organizations innovate and solve complex challenges for Fortune 500 companies and beyond, we want to hear from you. Opportunity! We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, AI, and customer delivery. You’ll partner directly with clients to understand complex business and technical challenges, rapidly design and build solutions, and integrate modern AI capabilities into real-world applications and systems. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong application development skills with a customer-focused mindset and enjoys taking solutions from initial discovery and architecture through implementation and deployment. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-ready applications and services. Solid application engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable software solutions. Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications and existing technology ecosystems. Strong experience designing and integrating APIs and distributed systems , including third-party services and enterprise platforms. Experience building solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies. Experience working with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or GCP . Proficiency with TypeScript and modern application development frameworks. Experience with agent orchestration , AI workflows, tool calling, or similar agentic architectures. Strong customer-facing and consulting skills , with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Experience with solution architecture , including designing scalable systems and making technical decisions based on customer and business requirements. Ability to work closely with customer stakeholders, product teams, and engineers throughout the solution lifecycle. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. Bonus points: Experience delivering technical solutions directly within customer environments . Experience designing or implementing RAG, AI agents, or multi-agent systems . Exposure to MLOps, model deployment, and AI observability . Experience working in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles. Experience rapidly building prototypes and proofs of concept and evolving them into production-ready solutions. Familiarity with modern data platforms, vector databases, and AI infrastructure. You’ll Love: Working directly with customers to solve complex, real-world technical challenges. Building and deploying AI-powered solutions that move quickly from concept to production. Combining hands-on engineering with solution architecture and customer collaboration. Working across application engineering, cloud technologies, and modern AI systems. Exploring emerging AI technologies and finding practical ways to apply them to meaningful business problems. By joining our team, you’ll be part of a winning squad that plays to each other’s strengths and celebrates every success together. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: POS-33676 Application Deadline: Monday, Nov 30th at 9am ET Role Summary Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. AI is central to that mission—and on the AIMS (AI Marketing Solutions) team, you’ll help shape how Generative AI powers HubSpot ’s next chapter of growth. As a Senior AI Engineer, you’ll operate at the intersection of AI, engineering, and product strategy. You’ll partner with marketers and leaders to turn ambitious ideas into scalable AI solutions, while bringing clarity to complex technical decisions. This role blends hands-on development with technical leadership—building production-grade systems and influencing how AI is applied across the business. What You’ll Do Design and deploy scalable, cloud-based architectures for AI-driven marketing applications. Lead AI research and development efforts from early exploration through production delivery. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into testable AI solutions. Build and optimize data pipelines, retrieval systems (RAG), vector databases, and multi-agent workflows. Develop and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Java, Node.js, or Python. Own end-to-end solution design, including prototyping, testing, training, and support processes. Evaluate and prioritize AI initiatives based on feasibility, scalability, and business impact. Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.

Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R&D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world's number one customer agent!

What's the opportunity? 

Fin's Machine Learning team is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.

We are an extremely product focussed team. We work in partnership with Product and Design functions of teams we support. Our team's dedicated ML product engineers enable us to move to production fast, often shipping to beta in weeks after a successful offline test.

We are very passionate about applying machine learning technology, and have productized everything from classic supervised models, to cutting-edge unsupervised clustering algorithms, to novel applications of transformer neural networks. We test and measure the real customer impact of each model we deploy.

What will I be doing? 

  • Identify areas where ML can create value for our customers
  • Identify the right ML framing of product problems
  • Working with teammates and Product and Design stakeholders
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and research
  • Deeply understand the problem area
  • Research and identify the right algorithms and tools
  • Being pragmatic, but innovating right to the cutting-edge when needed
  • Perform offline evaluation to gather evidence an algorithm will work
  • Work with engineers to bring prototypes to production
  • Plan, measure & socialize learnings to inform iteration
  • Partner deeply with the rest of team, and others, to build excellent ML products

What skills might I need? 

  • Broad applied machine learning knowledge
  • 3-5 years applied ML experience
  • Practical stats knowledge (experiment design, dealing with confounding etc)
  • Intermediate programming skills
  • Strong communication skills, both within engineering teams and across disciplines.
  • Comfort with ambiguity
  • Typically have advanced education in ML or related field (e.g. MSc)
  • Scientific thinking skills

Bonus skills & attributes 

  • Track record shipping ML products
  • PhD or other experience in a research environment
  • Deep experience in an applicable ML area. E.g. NLP, Deep learning, Bayesian methods, Reinforcement learning, clustering
  • Strong stats or math background
  • Visualization, data skills, SQL, matplotlib, etc.

Benefits 

We are a well treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us! 

  • Competitive salary, annual bonus and equity
  • Regular compensation reviews - we reward great work!
  • Generous paid time off above statutory minimum
  • Generous family leave (maternity, paternity), to let you spend valuable time with your loved ones
  • Hybrid working

  • Unlimited access to Claude Code and best-in-class AI tools; experimentation & building is encouraged & celebrated
  • Fun events for employees, friends, and family!

Advanced working knowledge of Python, R, SQL, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and modern data science libraries for building scalable analytical solutions. Hands-on, production-level experience designing, training, validating, deploying, and monitoring machine learning models, including regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, recommendation systems, and natural language processing applications. Strong SQL skills and meaningful experience performing data exploration, feature engineering, query optimization, ETL development, data visualization, and business intelligence reporting using enterprise data platforms. Solid experience with Git-based version control workflows, CI/CD processes, MLOps practices, model deployment pipelines, code review processes, and collaborative software development methodologies. Hands-on experience deploying machine learning solutions on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including managed AI/ML services, storage, networking, and identity management capabilities. Strong debugging, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills, with the discipline to investigate complex data challenges methodically, communicate findings effectively, and translate analytical insights into actionable business recommendations. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing and deploying real-time machine learning systems, recommendation engines, streaming analytics, event-driven architectures, or large-scale AI applications using Kafka, Spark Streaming, or equivalent technologies. Exposure to advanced artificial intelligence concepts such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, generative AI, large language models (LLMs), explainable AI (XAI), model fairness, and responsible AI practices. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Your Role We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Research who is versatile: you model high-stakes business problems—revenue optimization, risk management, and related questions—and you use AI to scale that work. You'll be a senior individual contributor who can go deep statistically, learn a new domain quickly, and rethink how data science problems get solved in the age of AI: not only classical models, but agents and other AI systems that multiply what a small research team can do. This role is for someone who is deeply curious, strong at analytical thinking and problem solving, and a fast learner—with formal training and a strong statistical foundation. You have tackled revenue and risk problems with modeling before, and you are excited to solve them differently now: building AI agents, automating research workflows, and using modern tools so the science scales. If you want ownership over modelizable, revenue- and risk-critical problems and you already leverage AI to move faster, this is the role. What You'll Do Tackle revenue and risk problems with modeling. Frame ambiguous business questions as quantitative problems; build models that improve revenue, manage risk, and inform decisions. Solve them differently in the age of AI. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina. We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. About the role: As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. The company builds software for commercial real estate. This isn't general cloud engineering, you will actually built agentic-platform infrastructure before, not just traditional cloud architecture. Responsibilities: Model Design & Delivery Design, train and ship production ML models for real estate and facilities decisions, such as forecasting for space, occupancy, headcount, rent and finances Own each model end to end: problem framing, data and features, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and cost and latency budgets Serve models as versioned, documented APIs that product features, agents and other systems call. Keep the serving layer portable across cloud platforms, for example by using containers Contribute to embedding and retrieval work, and measure retrieval quality on real customer documents Contribute to synthetic data pipelines, so teams can develop and test without production customer data. Measure how closely the synthetic data matches the real data, how well models trained on it perform, and whether it leaks private data Evaluation, Quality & Trust Own the evaluation of every model you ship: backtests, held-out datasets, metrics that fit the problem, and regression suites in CI that gate releases Build them on the shared evaluation framework that the platform team provides Find the root cause of quality failures, whether data drift, leakage, a feature defect, flawed ground truth, a retrieval miss or a model regression. Fix the layer that is at fault Monitor production models for accuracy, drift, silent degradation and cost Retrain or roll back based on evidence Own model-level safety behavior: keep customer data within each tenant’s access rules, handle PII correctly, test for privacy leakage, and disclose uncertainty clearly Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Product to turn accuracy thresholds and confidence disclosure into shipped behavior Agree on API contracts, accuracy bars and failure behavior with the teams that build AI agents on your models. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment and with Data Platform on the curated datasets and features your models read Feed model performance and usage data into the warehouse, so model quality is measurable next to product analytics Support the domain teams that build on your models, contribute to the shared quality standard for models and agents, and mentor engineers on ML practice Requirements: You have taken at least one ML model from problem framing to production, and kept it accurate through retraining and drift. Typically 5+ years of professional engineering experience and a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience Python and SQL, including the ML stack (scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent, pandas or equivalent) and the service stack (FastAPI, Pydantic or equivalent) Testing, code review, CI/CD and production ownership. You use AI coding assistants and verify their output Hands-on experience with ML evaluation: time-aware validation and backtesting against simple baselines, holdout design, metric selection, interval coverage and calibration, error analysis, and using results to gate releases. This is central to the role Production experience with forecasting models, with a working knowledge of statistics and probability. You can quantify uncertainty, for example with prediction intervals Model serving and MLOps: reproducible deployment, monitoring and retraining, for example with experiment tracking, a model registry, containers, and batch or online inference Judgment about failure modes such as data leakage, drift, distribution shift, bias, privacy leakage and silent degradation. You can tell acceptable failures from unacceptable ones, and explain model behavior and uncertainty to Product and to people who are not engineers Desirable: Embeddings and retrieval systems, including how to measure retrieval quality Synthetic data generation, privacy attack evaluation (for example membership inference), and familiarity with differential privacy Geospatial or location data modeling Experience building models that LLM agents call as tools, with an agent framework such as LangGraph and LLM tracing tools Batch pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions or equivalent) and self- hosted model inference Experience in real estate, facilities, finance or another data-heavy enterprise domain What’s in it for you? Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays Flexibility: 100% remote work mode Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients Welcoming en

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.jd: 🌍 Hello World! We are The Codest - International Tech Software Company with tech hubs in Poland delivering global IT solutions and projects. Our core values lie in “Customers and People First” approach that prioritises the needs of our customers and a collaborative environment for our employees, enabling us to deliver exceptional products and services. Our expertise centers on web development, cloud engineering, DevOps and quality. After many years of developing our own product - Yieldbird, which was honored as a laureate of the prestigious Top25 Deloitte awards, we arrived at our mission: to help tech companies build impactful product and scale their IT teams through boosting IT delivery performance. Through our extensive experience with product development challenges, we have become experts in building digital products and scaling IT teams. But our journey does not end here - we want to continue our growth. If you’re goal-driven and looking for new opportunities, join our team! What awaits you is an enriching and collaborative environment that fosters your growth at every step. Our client is one of the largest e-commerce platforms in Europe, used by millions of users every day. The company connects sellers - from small businesses to global brands - with customers, offering a vast product selection, fast delivery, and a well-crafted shopping experience. Project description: The project focuses on supporting the R&D team in developing and scaling an innovative Product Knowledge Graph solution from the Proof of Concept (PoC) stage to a full-scale production environment within an e-commerce platform. The main objective is to build a structured product knowledge system capable of identifying and analyzing complex semantic relationships between products, their use cases, and user intentions. The solution goes beyond traditional product titles and attributes, capturing product complementarity, usage contexts, and explainable relationships. The project combines R&D, data processing, and advanced knowledge modeling to support the development of intelligent solutions for a large-scale e-commerce platform. Key Responsibilities: Designing, training, and evaluating models based on Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to build concept graphs, establish concept hierarchies, and map them to a product catalog containing millions of items. Scaling data processing pipelines and generating vector representations (product and concept embeddings) for downstream applications, including recommendation systems. Conducting iterative experiments, including reviewing state-of-the-art (SOTA) research, defining evaluation metrics, refining prompts, and calibrating annotated datasets. Preparing solutions for production deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams, including readiness for A/B testing. Requirements Minimum 4–5 years of commercial experience as a Senior Data Scientist or Machine Learning Research Engineer, working on large-scale data projects. Education: University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related STEM field. R&D Expertise: Proven experience in end-to-end research and development projects, from reviewing state-of-the-art (SOTA) research and formulating hypotheses to designing experiments, conducting offline/online validation, and delivering production-ready solutions. NLP & LLM: Hands-on experience with modern Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, information extraction, synthetic data generation and cleaning, semantic clustering, and working with Transformer-based models and Sentence Encoders. Deep Learning & Python: Strong proficiency in Python and the ML/DL ecosystem, including PyTorch or TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn. Ability to write clean, testable, production-quality code and work with CI/CD pipelines. Large-Scale Data Processing: Advanced SQL skills, including analytical SQL for large datasets, and experience processing data in cloud environments (experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, Vertex AI, and Vertex AI Pipelines). English level min. B2+ Nice to have: Knowledge Graphs & GNNs: Experience in designing, building, or working with Knowledge Graphs, graph databases, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Big Data & Low-Latency ML: Experience in processing data at massive scale or developing low-latency ML systems with response times measured in tens of milliseconds, such as search or recommendation systems. E-commerce / RecSys / Search: Strong understanding of modern recommendation system architectures, including Two-Tower models, retrieval, ranking, and complementary product recommendations, or semantic search solutions (ANN / vector search). Data Annotation: Experience in designing and managing data annotation processes, including collaboration with annotation teams, refining annotation guidelines, and evaluating data quality and consistency. Recruitment process: 30-minute screen with our recruiter, Justyna Technical Verifcation with our developer Client Technical Verification Meetings Stakeholder meeting Offer Questions, insights? Feel free to reach out to our recruiting team: In the meantime, feel free to visit our website where you can find key facts about us. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Product
jobs.jd:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Assistant team, led by Remi Takase, Senior Data Science Manager. The team is part of a passionate and skilled data organisation of Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Engineers and SREs, building on a state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Data platform. The Mirakl Assistant team is a new team that runs like a start-up inside a scale-up. Together, you'll be designing, building and scaling the conversational AI assistant that changes how our users work across Mirakl products.

The assistant knows the platform and the users, and helps them get the most out of Mirakl, from finding their way around the product, to understanding their business and growing it. We're taking it from conversational to action-oriented: users ask, and the assistant gets it done.

AI agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software: what customers expect from it, how they interact with it, and how they integrate it into their business. At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.

The position is a permanent contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. 

2. Your Impact

  • Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature
  • Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience
  • Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products
  • Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience
  • Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach
  • Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design
  • Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation

Skills:

  • LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)
  • Software engineering proficiency in Python
  • Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental
  • Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation
  • A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production
  • Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact 
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus

4. Tech Stack

  • Languages: Python, SQL, TypeScript
  • Backend: FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL
  • Frontend: React (micro-frontend architecture)
  • AI: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
  • Data Platform & Orchestration:<

jobs.jd: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist , Amazon Leo Networking Software
jobs.jd: Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world, including those underserved by traditional infrastructure. Operating a live constellation and its ground network at scale means service disruptions are an inevitable reality, and how quickly we detect them, understand them, and prevent them from recurring defines the trust we earn as a connectivity provider. We are seeking a talented Senior Data Scientist to build the next generation of observability and availability science for the Leo network. Leo already detects outages, notifies affected customers, and restores service. The frontier is prediction and prevention: reasoning over complex network and ground-segment telemetry to autonomously detect anomalies before they reach customers, attribute root cause automatically across a sprawling event surface, and rationalize a large, still-maturing metric set so responders trust what the system tells them. In this role you will work backwards from the needs of customers and operations teams. You will own the scientific direction end to end, partnering closely with network engineers, the Network Operations Center, and the Incident Management team, and the Software and Networking orginization to translate a long-term science vision into concrete research and delivery roadmaps. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Own the observability and availability science end to end, from long-term vision to research roadmap to production delivery, working backwards from the needs of customers, the NOC, and network engineering. * Develop time-series and graph-based models with dynamic baselining that detect network and ground-segment anomalies before they cross the High Severity threshold, enabling proactive investigation rather than reactive response. * Reason over complex, multi-system telemetry to attribute cause automatically during live HSEs and LSEs, so Call Leaders and engineers spend time mitigating, not hunting. * Provide the science behind the network's bucketed availability decomposition (geometric and satellite coverage, ground and network segments, customer terminals, payload, and planning), attributing every movement to a true cause rather than noise, so leadership steers on signal and engineering effort lands where it actually moves availability and throughput. * Deliver the models, analyses, and metrics that feed the daily system readiness and validation review consumed by senior leadership and product and engineering, turning availability and throughput data into a defensible, evidence-based read on progress against GA entry criteria. * Own the recurring, fleet-wide "hot topic" investigations that span ASIC, firmware, payload, network, and planning, separating correlated symptoms from true root cause across thousands of nodes, quantifying how much availability or throughput each is costing, and answering whether it is a launch-blocking risk and whether it is improving. * Deliver alert correlation and deduplication, false-positive reduction, and metric-quality scoring so responders trust what the system tells them, directly supporting a large, still-maturing KPI set. * Tie your science to the unit the org actually measures: reduce detection and attribution time, raise availability against the network's bar, and increase the share of events prevented before customer impact. * Partner day to day with the Network Operations Center, Network Engineering, and the Incident Management (Call Leader) program; sit on live HSE/LSE bridges as the science partner and turn event learnings into model improvements. * Feed COEs and RCAs back into detection and attribution so recurring signatures are caught earlier, and help design and score gamedays that stress-test both the network and your models against real, closed events. * Build and deploy production pipelines on AWS (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue) with model validation, monitoring, drift detection, and explainability, because operations teams must be able to trust and act on model output under pressure. * Set data-science standards, mentor scientists, and drive best practices across the Leo networking organization as the science function scales. * Produce explainable output and written narratives that let responders and leaders three or more levels up act on your models during and between events. A day in the life You might start by reviewing overnight anomaly detections and availability movements, join an HSE bridge as the science partner by midday, and spend the afternoon refining root-cause attribution models or presenting availability findings at the readiness review. About the team Amazon Leo Networking Software builds and operates the software behind Leo's satellite and ground network. Our science function partners with the NOC, Network Engineering and Incident Management to make the network more available and resilient, moving from reacting to outages to predicting and preventing them. As a Data Scientist III, you'll help shape that function as it grows. - 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 4+ years of data scientist experience - Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression - 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience - Experience managing data pipelines - Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.jd:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members.

You’ll develop and improve machine learning models that identify harmful listings and suspicious behaviour across the marketplace, while minimising friction on legitimate members. Working with text, images and behavioural data, you’ll apply practical machine learning techniques to evolving detection challenges.

You’ll work closely with Data Scientists, Decision Scientists, Product Managers and engineers to turn ideas into reliable production solutions. You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects across the ML lifecycle, from understanding the data and developing models to deployment, evaluation and ongoing maintenance.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Develop, evaluate and improve machine learning models that detect harmful content and behaviour at scale.
  • Engineer features, prepare training and evaluation datasets, understanding their limitations and addressing issues such as noisy labels, class imbalance and data leakage.
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate models into production and develop reliable training and inference pipelines using established tooling.
  • Work with Decision Scientists and Product Managers to define success metrics and evaluate model improvements through offline analysis and online experimentation, balancing detection coverage with false positives and member experience.
  • Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in their effectiveness and improve them as harmful behaviour and underlying data evolve.
  • Write reliable, maintainable and reproducible code, document your work, share learnings and contribute ideas to the team’s roadmap.

About you 

  • Practical experience developing machine learning solutions, with a solid foundation in machine learning, statistics and probability theory.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn or PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience preparing training datasets, engineering features, training models and evaluating them against baselines and metrics.
  • Experience applying machine learning to at least one of the following: tabular or behavioural data, natural language processing, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with the production ML lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring and retraining.
  • Ability to break down problems into manageable steps, work independently within an agreed scope and seek input when needed.
  • Ability to communicate your approach, findings and trade-offs clearly, collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues, and learn from feedback.
  • Motivation to apply machine learning to member safety, with care for data privacy and the consequences of incorrect predictions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud detection, content classification or other Trust & Safety applications.
  • Experience with transformers, multimodal models or LLM-based workflows.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Integrity
jobs.jd: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Integrity team protects people and businesses using ChatGPT, Codex, and the API from fraud, abuse, and harmful misuse. Our work spans payment and promotional abuse, compromised accounts and API credentials, business and advertiser integrity, and emerging misuse of frontier AI capabilities. We also help product teams measure authentic usage so that abuse doesn’t distort decisions about how our products are growing. Integrity Data Science helps teams decide where to intervene and whether those interventions work. A payment control can prevent fraud while blocking legitimate purchases. A product launch can make it easier for customers to get started while creating new opportunities for abuse. We measure both sides of those decisions. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Data Scientist on Integrity, you’ll find emerging abuse patterns, size their impact, and lead the analytical work behind decisions about detection, enforcement, and product launches. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Research, Policy, and Operations to turn findings into improvements and measure what happens after they ship. - Investigate anomalous activity across products. Estimate how common a problem is, who is affected, and what it costs users or the business. Use that evidence to recommend where to focus. - Define outcome metrics and guardrails, establish baselines, and build monitoring that surfaces changes in abuse, customer friction, and operational performance. - Help build and evaluate detection rules, classifiers, and human review workflows. Use labeled samples and review outcomes to understand what the systems miss, where they flag legitimate activity, and how those errors vary across users and products. - Design randomized holdouts and use quasi-experimental or observational methods when randomization is impractical. Estimate harm or fraud losses prevented alongside effects on legitimate users, revenue, compute costs, and review workload. Recommend whether to launch, expand, adjust, or retire a control. - Trace where signals, review decisions, or enforcement actions break down. Work with partners to close gaps and build reusable datasets, analyses, and investigation tools. IDEAL CANDIDATE - You use AI tools to investigate large, messy datasets, test hypotheses quickly, and automate recurring analyses. You’re fluent in SQL and Python and can verify AI-generated queries, code, and conclusions against the underlying data. - You have strong statistical judgment and experience with experimentation, causal inference, or observational analysis. You can reason from incomplete or biased labels and explain how uncertainty affects a decision. - You take ownership of open-ended problems, from deciding what to measure through recommending an action and checking whether it worked. - You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners and can explain the tradeoffs behind a recommendation. - Experience in integrity, trust and safety, fraud or risk analytics, security analytics, or applied ML evaluation is helpful. Experience evaluating detection systems, human review, or LLM-based classifiers is a plus. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: AI Engineer, DevEx & Automation
jobs.jd:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Agentic Developer Experience Engineering team led by Benoit Lateltin, AI Transformation Program Lead.

The team currently consists of 3 Software Engineers, 100% dedicated to building the agentic tooling powering all of Mirakl Labs. Together, you'll be designing, shipping and running AI agents and assistants that transform how 330+ engineers, Product Managers, Designers and QAs work every day.

Please note this role requires to be based 4 days at the office, per week.

Your Impact

  • Build agents and assistants as products - across the full software development lifecycle (code review, tech design, maintenance, incident response), from first prototype to tools teams genuinely rely on every day.
  • Define and expand AI delegation safely - set the human control points, guardrails and evaluation frameworks; measure the autonomy rate per task type and extend what agents handle as trust builds over time.
  • Turn team pain points into working software - sit with engineers, PMs, QAs and designers to find the real friction, prototype fast, pilot with volunteer squads, and scale what works.
  • Build the knowledge infrastructure agents consume - along with tooling for usage, cost and impact monitoring, leveraging the Data & Agentic Platform and DevExp foundations rather than rebuilding them from scratch.
  • Make every product measurable - adoption rate, time saved, quality, cost: nothing ships without its metrics.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, Developer Productivity, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, with experience building reliable, maintainable and production-ready systems
  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-powered products, using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents
  • Experience applying AI to software development workflows, such as code review, technical design, testing, documentation, maintenance or incident response
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and integrating developer tools, code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers or documentation platforms
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving their reliability, quality and level of autonomy, through appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop mechanisms
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineers and cross-functional teams
  • Curiosity, pragmatism and a strong product mindset, with a passion for turning real developer pain points into useful AI-powered solutions
  • Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can better understand what you have built and worked on!

 

Tech Stack

  • Java, Python, TypeScript
  • Agentic stack: Coding Agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, pi.dev) , MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models), evaluation frameworks
  • Infrastructure: GitHub Actions/CI, Kubernetes, Datadog

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best poss

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions . You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks. Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams , and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction. What you'll do at UiPath Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance. Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases. Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements. Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently. Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments. Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders. Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages). Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems. Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication. Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. Our core principles Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success. Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution. Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn. Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs. Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned. Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy .
